div.p: We've written this in plain language. It covers who we sell to, what the products are, how the regulatory framework works, and what your responsibilities are as a buyer. If you have questions, just ask.

section.class: s_text_block o_cc o_cc1 pt48 pb96 o_colored_level

div.p: BioElevate sells exclusively to licensed medical professionals, clinics, and qualified distributors. We do not sell to the general public or to individual patients.

To place an order, you need to be operating in a professional capacity - as a licensed physician, clinic operator, compounding pharmacy, or pharmaceutical distributor. We verify this before processing orders.

Peptide-related products may be available through different regulatory pathways depending on the product type, intended use, and jurisdiction.
Availability, distribution, and use requirements can vary and should be evaluated according to applicable laws and regulations.

Some compounds in our catalog have established regulatory pathways for licensed compounding pharmacies. Others are available for international markets. The product catalog clearly shows the availability status of each compound.
In the United States, peptide compounds fall into a few categories:

ul.li: FDA-approved finished drugs available only through authorized channels.
Compoundable compounds - like NAD+ and Sermorelin - that can be legally prepared by licensed compounding pharmacies for individual patients with a valid prescription.
Research or non-approved compounds that may be restricted depending on jurisdiction and intended use.

div.h4: What you're responsible for as a buyer
div.p: When you purchase from BioElevate, you take on responsibility for:

ul.li: Verifying that each product is legal to import, compound, dispense, or distribute in your jurisdiction.
Ensuring use only under licensed professional oversight where required.
Maintaining proper storage, handling, and cold-chain practices after receipt.
Using products in compliance with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations.

div.p: If you're unsure about the regulatory requirements for a specific product in your jurisdiction, we recommend speaking with a qualified healthcare attorney or regulatory consultant before ordering.

Every product we supply is tested for purity (>=99% by HPLC), identity (mass spectrometry), and endotoxin levels. You receive a lot-specific Certificate of Analysis with every order. We do not supply products that do not meet these standards.
Products are stored and shipped at 2-8C with validated cold-chain packaging. Temperature logs are available on request.

The information on this website is for professional reference only. It is not medical advice and does not constitute a recommendation to prescribe, administer, or use any product. BioElevate Universal makes no claims about the therapeutic efficacy of any compound. Product descriptions are for informational purposes only. Regulatory information reflects our best understanding at the time of publication and may change - always verify current status with qualified counsel before making purchasing decisions.
